name: hot hot hot
author: AnnihilatorX3000
description: when you have a bad case of blue balls but one of them is missing so the other sets out on a journey to reunite with the missing ball. however, trapped within its own body, the ball is unable to control itself. paralysed, the ball tumbles down the slippery slopes and faces countless roadblocks along its inevitable path. at last, the ball comes to a halt. the ball thanks the game designer for their mercy. however, the ball quickly realises that the suffering was necessary in bringing the two balls closer together. but no matter how ready the ball is to face the pain once again, there seems to be no way to progress any further. with the other ball still not in sight, any remaining hope begins to crumble. the ball lies motionless as it weeps in defeat. will the two balls ever reunite? find out in the next episode
